title: Fiber Laser Cutting Machines, 1.5–80 kW, Canada | NovoTech
meta_description: Every sheet metal laser sold by NovoTech in Canada: Dener GFL and Smart fiber lasers, 3 – 40 kW, and the Senfeng value line from 4 × 4 ft to 80 kW gantries.
h1: Laser cutting machines for sheet and plate — 4 × 4 ft to 10 × 164 ft, 1.5 to 80 kW
intro: A fiber laser cutting machine cuts sheet and plate from a DXF file with a focused beam — mild steel to 1-1/2″ and beyond with the high-power sources, stainless and aluminum to 1″ — at speeds no plasma or punch can match, with a clean edge and no tooling. NovoTech sells two lines of fiber lasers in Canada, each on its own page: the Dener lasers — the premium line, made in Turkey, the GFL production laser with a 1.5 G gantry and pallet changer and the Smart series to 13 × 82 ft, 3 to 40 kW; and the Senfeng lasers — the value line under its own brand, from 4 × 4 ft compact machines and the NP open-type to the H series with pallet changer to 80 kW, sheet-and-tube combos, plate gantries to 10 × 164 ft, 3D and coil-fed lines. Below, each line in brief, the laser power guide, and every model in one table of working area, power and speed; every machine comes with a CSA-approved panel, chiller, nesting software, a 1-year warranty and installation, training and parts from Mississauga, ON.

faq.q: Dener or Senfeng — which laser should I buy?
faq.a: Dener is the premium line: Turkish-built, with Precitec heads, IPG / nLIGHT sources and a heavier frame rated for 1.5 G, Dener Canada parts in Mississauga and the longer life at high duty — the machine for a job shop that cuts two shifts a day. Senfeng is the value line: a very large Chinese manufacturer (about 15,000 machines a year) that builds its own sources and heads, CE / FDA / ETL certified, at a price that puts a 12 kW laser within reach of a small shop — and with a range Dener does not cover: 4 × 4 ft compact machines, sheet-and-tube combos, 60 kW plate gantries, 3D and coil-fed lasers. Both are sold, installed and supported by NovoTech with the same CSA panel and warranty; we quote both so you can compare.

faq.q: What laser power do I need?
faq.a: Power sets the thickness and the speed. As a guide for mild steel: 3 kW cuts 1/2″, 6 kW 3/4″ (and 1/4″ at over 300 in/min), 12 kW 1″, 20 kW 1-1/4″ and 30 – 40 kW 1-1/2″ and beyond; stainless and aluminum run about 20 – 30 % thinner at the same power, with nitrogen or air assist. Most Canadian job shops buying today choose 6 or 12 kW: thick enough for structural work, fast enough to pay for the machine on thin sheet. Tell us your material mix and we run the cutting chart for you.

The model number is the nominal working area in centimetres: 3015 = 10 × 5 ft (3,000 × 1,500 mm) — a standard 4 × 8 or 5 × 10 sheet; 4020 = 13 × 6.6 ft; 6020 = 20 × 6.6 ft for 6 × 20 plate; 6025 and 8025 = 20 and 26 ft × 8.2 ft; 12526 = 41 × 8.5 ft. The 5 × 10 machine is the Canadian standard; buy the 6020 if you cut 20 ft plate or want to nest several sheets without reloading; the 4 × 4 ft Senfeng compact is for small parts in a small shop.

faq.q: Single table, double table or pallet changer?
faq.a: A single-table machine (Dener Smart open and semi-closed, Senfeng compact and NP) stops while you unload and load — fine for a few sheets an hour and the lowest price. A double table or pallet changer (Dener GFL and Smart closed, Senfeng H series) swaps tables in about 20 seconds, so the laser cuts while the operator loads: the difference between 40 and 70 % spindle time on a busy machine, and the base for a loading tower later.

faq.q: What about assist gas and fume extraction?
faq.a: Oxygen gives the fastest cut and an oxide edge on mild steel; nitrogen a clean, paint-ready edge on all metals; compressed air at 16 bar replaces nitrogen on sheet to about 1/4″ and cuts the gas bill to near zero — the intelligent air-cutting package is an option on both lines. The machines have pneumatic extraction compartments under the table and connect to a dust collector, which we can supply.

Yes — a loading / unloading tower that feeds the pallet changer, sheet storage with several shelves for lights-out production, part sorting, and bevel heads for weld preparation. The Dener GFL and closed-type Smart and the Senfeng H series are prepared for the tower; the Senfeng coil-fed lines go further and cut straight from the coil. Ask us for the automation layout.

faq.q: What does the machine need on site?
faq.a: A level floor, 600 V 3-phase (with the transformer we supply) or 480 V, a chiller (included), assist gas, a dust collector and a compressed-air supply for air cutting. A 6 kW 3015 draws about 30 kW in total and needs roughly 33 × 20 ft with a pallet changer. Delivery, installation and operator training are done by NovoTech from Mississauga, and the Ontario pre-start health and safety review is prepared by us.

faq.q: What voltage do these machines run on?
faq.a: Three-phase machines are supplied for 600 V as standard with a CSA-approved panel; 208 V, 240 V and 480 V 3-phase are available on request, and 240 V single-phase on models with a small enough motor. Manual machines have no electrics.
